project.title: Masque Character Creator
project.summary: PF2e Remaster session-zero and character creator for The Masque of Shattered Mirrors—one player, one GM, spoiler-safe handoff.

items.title: Support multiple saved character drafts
items.notes: Let users name, switch, and retain separate local drafts with clear replacement behavior. Preserve existing single-character saves and keep GM notes out of player storage. Multi-PC party balancing remains outside scope.

items.title: Export player characters for Pathbuilder
items.notes: Deferred pending a supported third-party character import format. Checked Pathbuilder Web 112.0 and developer documentation on 2026-11-11. Backup/Restore transfers native saves, Custom Pack imports rules content, and Export JSON sends character data out. Revisit when Pathbuilder documents a way to import external player builds.
